desc:
Climb a colorful tower as a squishy ASMR ball!

Stretch, bounce, and wobble past obstacles without falling.
Every hit deforms your ball in satisfying ways!

* Real soft-body physics
* Relaxing ASMR sounds
* Step on keyboards and pop objects
* Collect coins to unlock skins and gear
* Beware of the troll ahead!

Can you reach the top?

VIP servers are free! If you experience lag or other issues, try playing in one.

👍 Like and favorite the game for new towers and future updates!
